new_jobs.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.

We’re looking for a highly organized and proactive design program manager to support our design and product teams in delivering a world-class streaming experience. This role will focus on driving coordination and execution across product initiatives, ensuring alignment, clarity, and efficiency from concept to launch. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, understands design and product development workflows, and can manage multiple priorities with ease.

What You’ll Do

Support planning, tracking and delivery of multiple initiatives across design and product, ensuring alignment on priorities, goals and timelines.
Ensure design deliverables are aligned with product requirements.
Facilitate communication and decision-making across disciplines, including marketing, data and research.
Identify bottlenecks and propose improvements to design, product and engineering processes, supporting scalable ways of working across teams.
Facilitate the scoping of design requests from product, and communicate with stakeholders to help move product initiatives forward.
Own and facilitate meetings to drive progress against goals, resolve issues, identify clear next steps, and escalate roadblocks when necessary.
Communicate progress, risks and outcomes effectively to senior stakeholders and leadership.
Maintain project tracking tools, such as Jira, Confluence, Airtable and Figma.

Qualifications

3-5 years of experience as a project or program manager.
Strong understanding of design and product lifecycles, from roadmapping and initial requirements through final delivery and release.
Proven ability to work with product designers, product managers, and technology partners.
Ability to manage high-impact initiatives with competing deadlines, multiple stakeholders, and complex dependencies.
Ability to operate independently and multi-task in a rapidly evolving, fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with design tools (Figma, Sketch) and project management platforms (Jira, Confluence, Airtable).
Strong communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to provide clarity and structure in an environment of constant change.

Preferred Attributes

Experience in design or product operations, or design program management within a product-driven organization.
Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into actionable plans.
Comfortable facilitating discussions and driving alignment across cross-functional teams.
Experience managing design and product vendors and contractors.

Hybrid:
This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $130,000 - $170,000 (bonus and long-term incentive eligible).

Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. new_jobs.title: IT Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Overview

Job Overview:

The IT Project Manager is responsible for planning, executing, and delivering technology projects that align with business goals. This role ensures projects are completed on time, within scope, and on budget while managing risks, resources, and stakeholder expectations. The IT Project Manager collaborates with cross-functional teams, vendors, and leadership to drive project success through effective communication and problem-solving. By applying best practices in project management, they help optimize IT initiatives and contribute to the organization's digital transformation efforts.

Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities

Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success criteria in alignment with business goals.
Develop detailed project plans, schedules, and work breakdown structures.
Manage project execution, ensuring timely completion within scope, budget, and quality standards.
Collaborate with business units, IT teams, and executive stakeholders to define project requirements.
Facilitate regular status meetings and steering committee meetings, providing clear and concise project updates.
Manage stakeholder expectations and address concerns proactively.
Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and issues to minimize impact on timelines and budgets.
Develop contingency plans and escalate critical issues when necessary.
Monitor project budgets, ensuring cost control and efficient resource utilization.
Coordinate with internal teams and vendors to allocate resources effectively.
Work with external vendors, consultants, and service providers to ensure successful project delivery.
Manage contracts, service level agreements (SLAs), and vendor performance.
Apply appropriate project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid) based on project needs.
Lead Agile ceremonies (stand-ups, retrospectives, sprint planning) when managing Agile projects.
Ensure project deliverables meet IT governance, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance requirements.
Conduct testing, quality assurance, and user acceptance testing (UAT) coordination.
Maintain project documentation, lessons learned, and post-implementation reviews for future improvements.
Drive process optimization and best practices for IT project management.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.
3-7 years of experience managing IT projects, preferably in software development, infrastructure, or digital transformation.
Proven track record of successfully delivering IT projects on time, within scope, and within budget.
Project Management Professional (PMP) preferred.
Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or SAFe Agilist (SA) for Agile environments preferred.
Strong understanding of IT project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Hybrid).
Proficiency in project management tools (JIRA, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, ServiceNow, or similar).
Familiarity with IT governance, cybersecurity, and compliance standards.
Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and critical-thinking abilities.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for project reporting and presentations.
Ability to work in a hybrid work environment, balancing remote and in-office responsibilities as needed.
Experience managing vendors, contracts, and third-party service providers for IT projects.
Must be able to work both remotely and on-site as required, with a flexible schedule that includes in-office presence based on business needs
Experience with ERP systems such as Viewpoint Vista preferred
Experience in the construction industry preferred

new_jobs.title: Project Manager (Remoto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ)
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

The Role

Kyndryl Project Managers oversee the delivery of major projects within scope, schedule, and budget. You’ll be the driving force for every aspect of a program’s success, and the “conductor” who orchestrates everyone’s efforts to make beautiful music together. As the single point of contact to the client, you’ll also be the living embodiment of Kyndryl’s reputation every day.

As Project Manager, you have command of a very full and detail-oriented calendar. You’ll be constructing detailed project plans, managing teams, and leading meetings, status calls, and planning and cadence meetings. You will analyze and mitigate risks, manage finances, make sure the team has the right skills, then plan and delegate activity to hit deadlines, deliver on SLAs, and generally delight our clients. Of course, plans often evolve as a project unfolds, so you’ll need to practice continuous structural thinking and take ownership for value delivery, not just task scheduling.

But as important as planning and organization are, communication is 90% of the job. You’re the single point of contact with the client, partners, and all stakeholders, supporting them and ensuring they get what they need. You’re also the bridge to every other team on the project, including both technical and account roles. The result is an exciting multicultural, often multilingual environment. Bottom line: You need to like interactions with other people and know how to be kind and empathetic but also assertive — and handle customer change requests with diplomacy.

You’re going to be meeting a lot of people, networking, and forging relationships. Our “one team with the customer” concept means you’ll develop especially strong partnerships with the client and elsewhere. Some projects or clients even involve “embedding” with the client at their location. This puts more visibility on you personally, but it also gives you more opportunity to add value to the relationship. This is one of the things Kyndryls love about working here. It’s a great way to hone your service and people skills, and it lays the groundwork for career growth both laterally and vertically.

Your future at Kyndryl

Becoming a Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well-rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications. You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non-technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a senior project manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of PM roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best.

Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills and Experience:

Experience with SCRUM methodology or Project Management practices
Basic knowledge of IT architecture and systems
Strong organizational and planning skills
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment with a “One Team” mindset
Bachelor's degree in IT, Networking, or Business Administration
MBA or postgraduate degree in project management
Availability to travel, if needed
Availability to work remotely in Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience:

Fluent in English (both written and spoken) or proficiency in another relevant language, as required
Experience using MS Project or other Project Management tools/software
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proven ability to interact confidently with stakeholders at all levels

Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Position Overview

Giffen Consulting Ltd. (Giffen) is looking for an experienced Project Manager to join our growing team. This is a hybrid work arrangement with a minimum of 3 days per week in our Vancouver or Toronto office. Working across mining, utilities, and heavy industrial projects, you'll take ownership of multidisciplinary engineering projects from initiation through close-out while helping shape how we continue to grow as a company.

This is more than a project management role. It's an opportunity to influence project delivery, strengthen client relationships, mentor project teams, and contribute to the continued growth of a collaborative and entrepreneurial engineering firm. If you're looking for a role where your work has a visible impact, your ideas are valued, and your career can grow alongside the business, we'd love to hear from you.

About Us

Giffen is a Canadian company with offices in Vancouver, BC, and Toronto, ON. that provides fit-for-purpose engineering and project delivery solutions, specializing in the mining, utility, and heavy industrial sectors.

At Giffen, we take pride in our ability to deliver flexible strategies that are tailored to the specific needs of our clients. We value relationships above all else – within our team and with our clients. We hold our team to the highest level of accountability to ensure we provide tailored solutions to successfully execute our clients’ projects.

We believe that open communication is the key to fostering reliable and lasting relationships within our company and those with whom we conduct business.

Key Responsibilities

The ideal candidate will be able to ensure the financial success of our projects by managing project scope, schedule, and budgets here at Giffen. Responsibilities include:

Maintain and develop strong client relationships throughout the project lifecycle, including close-out. Identify, document, and communicate client requirements while effectively managing multiple stakeholders.
Proactively resolves performance, scope, cost, and schedule issues with the Client as they arise.
Ensure projects are managed in accordance with contract terms and conditions.
Clearly define project scope and ensure compliance with contract requirements.
Manage change and project interfaces while monitoring performance to identify and mitigate issues early.
Oversee all project scope elements, manage design, support procurement, and construction activities to align with the project schedule.
Support proposals and cost estimates.
Collaborate with the Project Services Team to establish cost reports, forecasting, approvals, trend identification, and cost-saving opportunities.
Define project quality requirements.
Support develop a project schedule that allows work to be executed efficiently while ensuring compliance with Company policies and procedures.
Provide clear and focused leadership to the project team, creating a vision for success and a strategy to achieve key milestones and objectives.
Ensure accurate and timely progress reporting to both the client and internal teams. Continuously monitor communication channels between project staff, the client, and third parties, implementing improvements as needed.
Identify project risks and opportunities, ensuring timely resolution and proactive mitigation strategies.
Set clear objectives for the design team and ensure adherence to the client's Basis of Design, regulations, and codes.
Ensure all HSE procedures are followed and that project participants understand and document compliance with safety requirements.

Qualifications + Experience

4+ years of progressive experience in a multidisciplinary engineering environment (EPC, EPCM, IPD, etc.).
Experience with complex projects values ranging from $500K - $10M.
Extensive knowledge relating to the engineering design phase of projects
Familiar with greenfield and brownfield mining / heavy industrial projects.
Knowledge of industry standards, regulations, and codes of practice.

Assets But Not Required

Registered as a Professional Engineer or Applied Science Technologist in Canada or eligible to register.
Project Management Professional (PMP) designation with the Project Management Institute (PMI).
The MMCD Certified Contract Administrator (MMCD CCA) designation.

What We Offer

Giffen is an open, welcoming, accepting, and positive space for all our employees and contractors. Here are some of the perks

of working for us!

Connect through monthly, continuous performance management meetings
Encourage continual learning through courses and conferences
Support professional designation certification
Invest in our people through a variety of corporate programs
Host company-wide social events

Why Join Our Team?

Small, growing team
Competitive compensation package including RRSP matching program
Employee Health Spending Account
Short + Long-Term Incentives
Flexible Work-From-Home option
Offices in Downtown Vancouver & Downtown Toronto

Job Description:

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. The CMM program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AO) in developing a modern cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States.

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Deputy
Technical
Program Manager
will lead the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team in delivering an integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill AO's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM program.

The successful candidate will be an experienced program leader with a long track record of successfully managing programs/projects with similar operations scope. The Program Manager is responsible for supervising all personnel, managing senior-level customer relationships, and overseeing delivery driving process and quality improvement. The successful candidate will be a change agent, not content with the status quo. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills are essential in this role. The role requires the ability to successfully juggle priorities in a fast-paced environment with multiple concurrent work streams. The successful candidate will thrive on the challenge and help the teams achieve a high degree of operational maturity.

The Deputy
Technical
Program Manager
will execute the following responsibilities:

Act as the single point of contact to oversee contract execution and ensure alignment with strategic goals.
Provides contract coordination, performance accountability, and strategic stakeholder engagement.
Operates with full authority to act for the Contractor on all contract matters relating to daily operations.
Serve as the senior technical authority across all development, architecture, integration, and modernization activities.
Define the program’s technical strategy, architecture vision, engineering standards, and modernization roadmap.
Ensure technical alignment with enterprise, security, and compliance standards.
Manage internal and external communications strategy, reporting, and coordination.
Responsible for the overall performance of the call order such as formulating work standards, assigning Contractor schedules and resources, reviewing performance, cost, and budget information; supervising Contractor personnel; and communicating policies, purposes, and goals of the organization to subordinates.
Ensure desired results by determining and implementing objectives and allocating appropriate resources.
Manage the development, operations, and implementation tasks using Agile Project Management techniques.
Create and maintain a roadmap, aligning tasks with organizational strategy, vision, and business outcomes for the CMM effort.
Facilitate project meetings, document meeting summaries, capture key decisions, and track action items.
Develop and maintain an Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) to include milestones, dependencies, and other details.
Provide biweekly Agile reports such as sprint reports, backlog reporting, sprint burndown charts, sprint retrospective reports, risk registry, etc.
Develop and update the Risks, Assumptions, Issues and Dependencies (RAID) log, and other project management related artifacts.
Perform risk identification and mitigation. Identify and communicate technical, operational, and business risks; develop mitigation strategies.
Provide transparent reporting, with regular updates to stakeholders on progress, risks, financials, and outcomes.
Provide the COR and government leads with analysis and research, of alternatives, and solution and design options related to the Case Management Modernization effort upon request.

QUALIFICATIONS:

10+ years’ experience in IT Management including technology solutions delivery with emphasis on data governance strategy, standards development, implementation, operation support, and change management services to accelerate modernization efforts.
The Deputy Technical Program Manager must possess bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university.
The Deputy Technical Program Manager must possess a Project Management Professional Certification (PMP).
Expertise in overseeing teams dedicated to big data cloud solution architecture, cybersecurity, data management, business intelligence and analytics.
Excellent customer-facing skills with experience briefing senior executive leadership.

Program Manager - Large Scale Client SaaS Implementation

Up to 10% travel to client in the Los Angeles, CA area.

Must be a current US Citizen and have a current CJIS certification or be willing to go through the extensive background check and obtain a CJIS certification.

Must have formalized Customer facing SaaS migration experience with over 3000 externally facing clients (not clients internal employees) moved.

At Lexipol, our mission is to create safer communities and empower individuals on the front lines with market-leading content and technology. Our top-notch team works closely with law enforcement, fire, EMS, corrections, adult probation, juvenile detention, and local government professionals to tailor our solutions to better address today’s challenges and keep first responders coming home safely at the end of each shift.

Working at Lexipol means making a difference - day in and day out.

The Work:

The Program Manager serves as the delivery leader for large, complex customer implementation program involving a SaaS deployment with integrations into other agency solutions for this very large and critical customer. This role is responsible for guiding the customer through the successful implementation and organizational adoption of Lexipol solutions by combining disciplined project management, business analysis, solution implementation, technical coordination, and organizational change management practices.

This position leads multi-phased implementation program for our Performance Reporting Suite Reporting Software for Public Safety | Lexipol from project initiation through post-production stabilization while serving as the primary point of contact to customer executive sponsors, business stakeholders, technical teams, and implementation partners. The Program Manager works closely with agency leadership to define business objectives, document functional and technical requirements, coordinate software configuration, oversee system integrations and historical data migration, manage project governance, and facilitate organizational readiness for the transition from legacy systems to the Lexipol platform.

The role partners with Lexipol Product, Engineering, Professional Services Specialists, Customer Success, and third-party vendors to ensure successful delivery of integrated solutions while minimizing operational disruption and accelerating customer adoption.

Enterprise Project Leadership (30%)

Lead enterprise SaaS implementation program utilizing formal project management methodologies and aligned to contractual requirements.
Develop comprehensive project management plans including scope, schedule, budget, risks, quality, communications, and stakeholder engagement.
Establish project governance, steering committees, executive reporting, and decision-making frameworks aligned to the contractual requirements from .
Facilitate recurring project meetings, executive briefings, status reporting, issue resolution, and risk management.
Coordinate cross-functional project resources across Lexipol, customer organizations, and third-party vendors.

Business Analysis & Solution Design (20%)

Facilitate discovery workshops with agency stakeholders.
Document business, functional, technical, reporting, security, and integration requirements, solution gaps, agency view of gap impacts, and other needs to meet contractual requirements from for project deliverables.
Develop or Partner with Cross Functional resources to create Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) documentation to meet contractual deliverables.
Document configuration decisions and any other project decisions ensuring alignment with agency approval processes per the contract.
Validate delivered functionality against documented requirements by overseeing both internal and external testing activities and documenting outcomes

Technical Delivery & Integration Coordination (20%)

Coordinate technical implementation activities supporting SaaS deployment.
Partner with customer IT teams to develop integration strategies between Lexipol and agency enterprise applications.
Coordinate API integrations, authentication, identity management, and data exchange activities.
Coordinate technical testing including all phases outlined by the contract needed to obtain appropriate agency approvals for work and invoicing approvals.

Organizational Change Management & Customer Adoption (15%)

Develop organizational readiness strategies supporting successful customer adoption.
Assess organizational impacts resulting from new business processes and technology.
Partner with agency leadership to establish change management strategies.
Develop communication plans supporting project milestones and organizational awareness.
Coordinate training strategies and end-user readiness activities.
Support executive sponsors in driving organizational adoption.

Customer Partnership & Stakeholder Management (15%)

Serve as the trusted advisor to executive sponsors and agency leadership.
Build collaborative relationships across command staff, operational leaders, technical teams, and project stakeholders.
Facilitate consensus among competing stakeholder priorities.
Manage customer expectations through transparent communication and proactive issue management.
Present project status, recommendations, risks, and mitigation strategies to executive leadership.
Support contract scope management and change request processes.

Required Experience: to be considered for the role, you will have this experience:

8-10+ years leading complex enterprise software implementation projects.

Demonstrated experience managing large governmental or public sector technology implementations.

Experience with large (over 3000 users) external customer facing system implementations for government contracts

Strong business analysis experience including requirements elicitation and SDLC documentation.
Experience leading enterprise SaaS implementations utilizing phased deployment methodologies.
Experience coordinating enterprise system integrations and data migration activities.
Strong understanding of Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid project delivery methodologies.
Experience facilitating executive steering committees and governance meetings.
Exceptional communication, facilitation, negotiation, and presentation skills.

Preferred:

PMP or Program Manager certification or equivalent project management certification preferred.
Public safety, law enforcement, corrections, fire, or local government experience.
Experience implementing CJIS-compliant or government SaaS applications.
Knowledge of enterprise integration technologies including REST APIs, SSO, Active Directory, Azure AD, and middleware platforms.
Experience with Microsoft Project, AdaptiveWork/Planview, Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, or equivalent PM platforms.
Prosci Change Management Certification or equivalent organizational change management experience.

Target Outcomes / Target Results

Deliver the program on schedule, within scope, and within agreed project budgets.
Successfully document and validate customer business requirements prior to solution configuration.
Coordinate successful system integrations and historical data migrations with minimal business disruption.
Maintain high customer satisfaction (CSAT) and executive stakeholder confidence throughout implementation.
Reduce project risks through proactive governance, issue management, and stakeholder communication.
Produce complete, accurate, and auditable SDLC documentation supporting enterprise implementations.

Employee Value Proposition

Influence and participate in shaping company strategies.
Work with premier Lexipol client.
High visibility within Lexipol.
Help this agency operate more efficiently.
Work with and bring together multiple technologies
Work with a leader in the public safety market

The Environment

Highly collaborative and supportive work environment
Passion filled culture: We have a passion for optimizing public safety.
Mission forward company: What we do makes a difference in communities.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Duties listed are not intended to be exhaustive or exclusive; other duties may be assigned. Management retains the discretion to add to or change the duties of the position at any time.

Compensation and Benefits

Lexipol offers a competitive base salary, monthly, quarterly, or annual incentive and a comprehensive benefits package including 401(k) with Company match and a flexible paid time off plan.
Base salary for this role is $115k to $130k, depending on experience, plus bonus opportunity.

About Lexipol

Lexipol is the leader in advancing total readiness for public safety agencies, helping leaders reduce risk, ease administrative burdens, and strengthen community trust. Trusted by more than 12,000 agencies nationwide, Lexipol delivers a unified platform that integrates policy, training, wellness, and reporting to simplify operations and support data-informed decisions. By equipping leaders and teams with the tools, insights, and support they need, Lexipol makes readiness possible today and for whatever comes next. Learn more at www.lexipol.com.

Transform how our global sales teams grow and succeed by designing high-impact training frameworks that accelerate learning and drive real-world performance. You will turn complex workflows into practical, engaging learning paths that empower professionals across the AECO sector.

Partner with senior leadership, product experts, and strategy teams to translate complex technical concepts and market data into actionable training modules.
Head cross-functional project squads to launch major enablement initiatives aligned with company growth goals and product launches.

Job Title: Program Manager, Platform Strategy & Launch Enablement

Location: East Hanover, NJ

Duration: 12 months

Pay Rate: $(56.00 – 88.00)/hr on W2 all-inclusive without benefits

Hybrid: 2-3 Days onsite and 2 days remote

About the Role

· Client is seeking a Program Manager, Platform Strategy & Launch Enablement to coordinate the technology and data initiatives required to support a select portfolio of high-priority commercial product launches.
· This role will serve as a key integrator across business, product, technology, CRM, data, analytics, and platform teams to help ensure launch-critical capabilities are delivered in alignment with business timelines and strategic objectives.
· In addition to traditional program management responsibilities, this role will provide platform strategy support by connecting related development efforts across teams, identifying dependencies and opportunities for alignment, and helping ensure investments contribute to a cohesive and scalable commercial technology ecosystem.
· The successful candidate will not be responsible for defining business requirements, owning individual product roadmaps, or managing delivery teams. Instead, the role focuses on bringing together the various technology and data efforts required to support successful brand launches while providing leadership with visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and readiness.
Key Responsibilities:

· Program Management & Delivery Coordination
· Lead program management activities across technology and data initiatives supporting designated launch brands.
· Maintain integrated plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and key decisions across participating teams.
· Coordinate activities across CRM, data, analytics, reporting, and platform workstreams.
· Monitor progress against delivery commitments and proactively identify risks to launch timelines.
· Facilitate cross-functional planning, status reviews, and readiness discussions.
· Platform Strategy & Integration
· Develop a comprehensive view of technology and data investments supporting launch objectives.
· Connect initiatives across platforms and teams to identify dependencies, overlaps, gaps, and opportunities for synergy.
· Help ensure launch-related capabilities align with broader platform strategies and technology roadmaps.
· Promote reuse, scalability, and consistency across technology and data solutions whenever possible.
· Partner with business and technology leaders to support informed investment and prioritization decisions.
· Launch Enablement & Readiness
· Track delivery of launch-critical technology and data capabilities.
· Coordinate readiness activities across participating teams.
· Maintain visibility into capability readiness, deployment plans, and key launch milestones.
· Identify and escalate issues that may impact launch support capabilities.
· Help ensure technology and data teams are aligned around launch objectives and critical delivery dates.
· Governance & Executive Communications
· Prepare executive dashboards, status reports, presentations, and leadership updates.
· Consolidate workstream updates into a single integrated view of progress and readiness.
· Facilitate governance forums and leadership reviews.
· Maintain visibility into risks, decisions, dependencies, and action items.
· Translate complex technical and operational information into concise business-focused communications.
Required Qualifications

· Bachelor's degree required.
· 5 years of experience in program management, PMO, business operations, platform operations, or related roles.
· Experience coordinating complex technology and data initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholders.
· Demonstrated ability to manage integrated plans, milestones, dependencies, and risks.
· Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
· Proven ability to influence and drive alignment in a matrixed environment.
· Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

· Experience supporting pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or life sciences organizations.
· Experience supporting commercial technology platforms, CRM ecosystems, customer engagement solutions, data platforms, or analytics capabilities.
· Experience supporting product launches, launch readiness activities, or launch enablement programs.
· Familiarity with CRM, customer data, reporting, analytics, omnichannel engagement, and commercial operations capabilities.
· Experience working within Agile or Product Operating Model environments.
· What Success Looks Like
· Technology and data capabilities required for priority launches are delivered on time and aligned to business needs.
· Dependencies and risks are identified early and managed proactively.
· Leadership has clear visibility into program status, readiness, and key decisions.
· Technology and data investments are coordinated across teams rather than managed in isolation.
· Launch teams are supported by scalable, reusable capabilities that strengthen the commercial platform ecosystem.
· Critical launches are enabled by well-coordinated technology and data solutions that are ready when the business needs them.

new_jobs.title: Senior Sales Enablement Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

Docker is looking for a Senior Sales Enablement
Program Manager
to design and produce the training and enablement content that powers our Go-To-Market (GTM) team. Reporting to the Head of Sales Enablement, you will work cross-functionally with Product Marketing (PMM), Product, Marketing, technical subject matter experts — including our AI Governance (AIG) overlay team — and GTM leaders to identify content needs, build clear requirements, and produce field-ready content — documents, videos, Mindtickle courses, quizzes, and certifications — that fuels GTM execution, effectiveness, and accuracy.

This role takes real technical understanding: you’ll need to get comfortable with how Docker’s product works — including newer, more technical areas like AI Governance — and translate that technical depth into simple, sales-ready value positioning the field can use with confidence. This isn’t a fully technical role, but it does require the curiosity and aptitude to learn technical features well enough to explain them simply.

This is a hands-on, creative role for someone who loves translating complex technical ideas into clear, engaging learning experiences, and who cares just as much about keeping content easy to find as they do about making it great. If you enjoy partnering across teams, building a single source of truth for enablement content, and making sure the field can always find what they need, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Content Needs & Requirements

Partner with PMM, Product, Marketing, technical subject matter experts, and GTM leaders to identify content needs and translate them into clear requirements.
Turn input from Sales and cross-functional stakeholders into structured content briefs and production plans.
Prioritize content requests based on business impact, GTM execution needs, and field urgency.

Content Production

Write, design, and produce enablement content across formats: documents, playbooks, one-pagers, and decks.
Build and maintain courses, quizzes, and certifications for onboarding and ongoing training within Mindtickle.
Develop scripts, storyboards, and recordings for training and demo videos in partnership with subject matter experts.
Partner with our AI Governance (AIG) overlay team to produce enablement content — feature walkthroughs, FAQs, talk tracks, and battle cards — that translates technical AI Governance capabilities into clear, sales-ready value positioning.
Build content that reinforces and extends Docker’s Command of the Message sales methodology, ensuring messaging, positioning, and value language stay consistent across all enablement materials.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with PMM, Product, Marketing, and technical subject matter experts to ensure content is accurate, timely, and aligned to launches and positioning.
Partner with GTM leaders to make sure training collateral supports GTM execution, effectiveness, and accuracy in the field.
Build a working technical understanding of Docker’s product — including AI Governance and other technical capabilities — directly from teams like AIG, then translate that understanding into content the field can use with confidence.
Serve as a liaison between Sales and Product, Marketing, and PMM to keep content grounded in what the field actually needs.

Content Governance & Findability

Own a single source of truth for enablement content, retiring duplicates and outdated material as new content ships.
Organize and tag content so it’s easy to search and find within Mindtickle and other systems, for both Sales and the broader GTM audience.
Maintain a consistent voice, structure, and visual standard across all enablement content.
Use completion data, quiz results, and field feedback to identify what’s working and what needs to be reworked.

Qualifications

Required

4+ years of experience creating content in a sales enablement, marketing, instructional design, or training role, ideally in SaaS.
Strong technical aptitude and curiosity — comfortable building a working understanding of Docker’s product and features (including more technical areas like AI Governance) and translating that understanding into simple, sales-ready value positioning. This role does not require deep engineering expertise, but does require the ability to learn technical concepts and explain them simply.
Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to turn complex or technical information into clear, engaging content.
Experience producing video content, from scripting through basic editing.
Comfort building courses, assessments, or certifications in an LMS (Mindtickle experience a plus).
Proven ability to manage multiple content projects at once and hit deadlines without sacrificing quality.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — you can work with PMM, Product, Marketing, technical subject matter experts, and GTM leaders, and manage competing priorities.
Experience organizing content so it’s easy to search, find, and trust as a single source of truth.
Excellent attention to detail and a strong sense of visual and brand consistency overall.

Strongly Preferred

Experience creating enablement content for technical, platform, or security/governance-related features (e.g., access controls, compliance, or AI governance).
Hands-on experience with Mindtickle or a similar sales enablement/LMS platform.
Experience with video recording/editing tools (e.g., Camtasia, Vidyard, Loom).
Familiarity with SaaS sales motions and Command of the Message or similar frameworks.
Experience organizing content libraries or knowledge bases — tagging, taxonomy, and search — in a CMS or LMS.
Background in graphic design or presentation design.
Exposure to containerization, DevOps tooling, or developer platforms (Docker experience a significant plus).

What To Expect

We believe in setting people up to win. Here’s what great looks like in this role:

First 30 Days — Learn & Listen

Ramp on Docker’s products, GTM motion, and existing enablement content library.
Meet with PMM, Product, Marketing, and GTM leaders to understand current content gaps.
Get up to speed on Mindtickle and the team’s other content and enablement tools.

First 90 Days — Take Ownership

Own production of at least one major piece of enablement content, start to finish, in partnership with PMM, Product, or Marketing.
Ship enablement content for at least one technical feature or launch — potentially in partnership with the AIG overlay team — translating it into clear value positioning.
Begin organizing the content library so it’s easier to search and find.

First Year — Drive Impact

Be the go-to owner for enablement content production, trusted by PMM, Product, Marketing, and GTM leaders.
Maintain a single source of truth for content that’s current, easy to navigate, and consistently used by Sales and the broader GTM audience.
Use engagement and feedback data to continuously raise the bar on content quality and findability.

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Compensation & Equity

Canada:
CA$184,450– CA$263,500 + equity

United States:
$133,000 – $190,00 + equity

AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

______________________________________________________________________

Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

new_jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.

Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.

Job Description

Senior Technical Project Manager – Automotive

Location: Michigan – Bloomfield Hills or Troy

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Project Manager
to join our Automotive Engineering Project Management organization.

In this role, you will lead complex, cross-functional engineering programs and strategic initiatives spanning software, hardware, systems engineering, validation, suppliers, finance, purchasing, and global engineering teams.

You will operate at the intersection of technology, business, and execution—creating clarity around priorities, driving accountability, proactively managing risks, and ensuring teams deliver against technical, schedule, financial, and customer commitments.

This is more than a project tracking role. We are looking for a leader who can understand complex technical environments, challenge assumptions, influence decisions, and continuously improve how our engineering organization executes.

What You'll Do

Lead Complex Technical Programs

Lead complex automotive engineering programs from ideation and concept exploration through development, driving execution in alignment with defined product development lifecycle phases, technical milestones, and gate requirements.
Develop and manage integrated project plans encompassing scope, schedule, technical deliverables, resources, budget, risks, dependencies, and milestones.
Partner closely with Engineering teams to understand technical architecture, requirements, dependencies, validation strategies, and implementation risks.
Drive execution across software, hardware, systems, validation, product, purchasing, finance, and other cross-functional organizations.
Establish clear ownership and accountability for project deliverables.
Drive timely resolution of technical and program-level issues affecting project commitments.

Drive Project Governance & Execution Excellence

Establish effective project governance, operating cadence, decision-making processes, and escalation mechanisms.
Define and monitor meaningful project KPIs and provide objective visibility into project health.
Lead program reviews, milestone reviews, risk reviews, and executive-level discussions.
Identify execution gaps and bottlenecks and establish actionable recovery plans.
Drive consistent project management standards and best practices across programs.
Champion continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve transparency, and increase engineering execution efficiency.

Manage Financial & Resource Performance

Manage project financial performance including budget, forecast, actuals, resource demand, external engineering spend, and financial risks.
Partner with Finance and Engineering leadership to maintain accurate forecasts and clear visibility into financial performance.
Monitor resource demand versus availability and identify capacity constraints that could impact project commitments.
Support annual operating planning, quarterly business reviews and ongoing forecast activities.
Drive financial discipline around project changes, external engineering expenditures, purchase orders, and supplier commitments.
Understand the connection between technical decisions, project execution, and financial outcomes.

Proactively Manage Risk & Change

Establish disciplined management of project risks, issues, actions, decisions, and dependencies.
Identify risks early and ensure appropriate mitigation plans, owners, and timelines are established.
Escalate critical issues with a clear understanding of technical impact, business impact, options, and recommended actions.
Lead cross-functional resolution of issues affecting cost, schedule, quality, technical performance, or customer commitments.
Ensure changes in project scope or requirements are evaluated for their downstream technical, resource, schedule, and financial impacts.

Lead Supplier & External Partner Execution

Coordinate execution with engineering suppliers and external service providers supporting software and hardware development.
Partner with Engineering and Purchasing to establish clear Statements of Work, deliverables, milestones, acceptance criteria, and supplier commitments.
Monitor supplier performance against technical, schedule, quality, and cost expectations.
Identify supplier-related risks and drive appropriate recovery and escalation plans.
Support effective management of external engineering investments.

Influence Across a Global Organization

Build strong partnerships across geographically distributed engineering teams and business functions.
Create alignment around priorities, commitments, dependencies, and decisions.
Influence outcomes without relying solely on organizational authority.
Translate complex technical and project information into concise, actionable insights.
Prepare and communicate project health, risks, financial performance, and critical decisions to senior leadership.
Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Who You Are

You are a technical project leader who is comfortable working in ambiguity and bringing structure to complex environments.

You combine technical curiosity with strong execution discipline. You ask the right questions, understand how technical decisions affect business outcomes, and know when additional depth is required from engineering experts.

You don't simply report project status—you help teams determine what needs to happen next.

You build trust across functions while maintaining accountability for commitments. You are comfortable communicating with engineers, suppliers, functional leaders, and executives and can adjust the level of detail appropriately for each audience.

Most importantly, you are passionate about creating better ways of working and helping teams deliver exceptional results.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or another related technical discipline.
8+ years of professional experience, including significant experience leading complex engineering or technical programs.
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional engineering programs with multiple teams, stakeholders, and dependencies.
Strong understanding of project/program management including scope, schedule, budget, resources, risk, change management, and governance.
Experience partnering directly with engineering teams in a product development environment.
Demonstrated ability to identify project risks and drive cross-functional resolution.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent written, verbal, and executive-level communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive results within a dynamic global organization.

Preferred

Experience within automotive, embedded systems, audio, or another complex technology/product development environment.
Experience managing programs involving embedded software, hardware, systems engineering, or integrated product development.
Experience working with automotive customers and automotive product development processes.
Experience managing engineering suppliers, external service providers, and Statements of Work.
Experience with engineering budgets, forecasting, resource planning, and external development costs.
Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Power BI, Excel, or equivalent platforms.
PMP, PgMP, Agile/Scrum, SAFe, ASPICE or equivalent certification is a plus.
Experience operating within globally distributed engineering organizations.

How You'll Make An Impact

Success in this role means creating greater predictability, transparency, and accountability across our engineering programs.

You Will Help Us

Deliver critical engineering commitments with greater predictability.
Identify risks before they become major execution issues.
Improve visibility into technical readiness, schedule, resources, and financial performance.
Strengthen collaboration between Engineering, Finance, Purchasing, Product, customers, and suppliers.
Establish scalable project management practices across the organization.
Continuously improve the efficiency and effectiveness of engineering execution.

Living the Bose Essence & Values

At Bose, how we work is as important as what we deliver
. As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you will bring our Essence and Values to life through the way you lead complex programs, solve problems, collaborate across teams, and deliver meaningful outcomes for our customers and company.

Tenacity

Respectfully challenge assumptions and teams to achieve better outcomes. Demonstrate persistence in navigating complex technical, schedule, resource, and business challenges while maintaining focus on commitments and customer outcomes.

Ingenuity

Listen, learn, anticipate, and apply technical and business insights to solve complex problems. Continuously identify opportunities to improve program execution, simplify processes, increase efficiency, and enable meaningful innovation.

Interconnected

Seek diverse perspectives and intentionally build strong partnerships across Engineering, Product, Finance, Purchasing, suppliers, customers, and global teams. Create alignment across functions and regions to unlock the collective potential of the organization.

Empowered

Lead with integrity, ownership, and accountability. Proactively identify risks and opportunities, drive decisions, remove barriers, and take responsibility for delivering against technical, financial, schedule, and customer commitments.

Together, these behaviors support the Bose Essence
— to invent, advancing science and art to deliver transformative experiences —and our belief in the power of sound. For a Senior Technical Project Manager, this means creating the environment, structure, and execution discipline that enables our engineering teams to turn innovative ideas into exceptional customer experiences.

At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of Troy, Michigan is: $109,700-$150,875.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary. In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic-drop. Let’s Make Waves.

‎

At PwC, our people in data and analytics engineering focus on leveraging advanced technologies and techniques to design and develop robust data solutions for clients. They play a crucial role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth.

In data engineering at PwC, you will focus on designing and building data infrastructure and systems to enable efficient data processing and analysis. You will be responsible for developing and implementing data pipelines, data integration, and data transformation solutions.

Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team member’s unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.

Skills

Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:

Analyse and identify the linkages and interactions between the component parts of an entire system.
Take ownership of projects, ensuring their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.
Partner with team leadership to ensure collective ownership of quality, timelines, and deliverables.
Develop skills outside your comfort zone, and encourage others to do the same.
Effectively mentor others.
Use the review of work as an opportunity to deepen the expertise of team members.
Address conflicts or issues, engaging in difficult conversations with clients, team members and other stakeholders, escalating where appropriate.

Uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.

When you join PwC Acceleration Centers (ACs), you step into a pivotal role focused on actively supporting various Acceleration Center services, from Advisory to Assurance, Tax and Business Services. Oversee business analysis for data engineering projects
Collaborate with clients to gather and document requirements

Mentor junior analysts and promote skill development

new_jobs.description:

Travel Required

Up to 10%

Ability to Obtain Public Trust

What You Will Do

You will support high-impact initiatives for the Food and Drug Administration in a dual change management and training role, helping teams plan, coordinate, communicate, and execute the week-to-week activities required for successful system implementation and adoption. This role requires strong project management discipline, the ability to collaborate across workstreams and functional areas, and comfort engaging FDA leadership and stakeholders at multiple levels. Primary responsibilities will include:

Serve as a trusted advisor to FDA leadership, program offices, and client stakeholders on change management, training, operational readiness, and system implementation priorities
Build and maintain strong client relationships across FDA leadership, program offices, business owners, end users, and external stakeholders
Facilitate client-facing executive meetings, working sessions, stakeholder discussions, training sessions, and leadership briefings
Lead week-to-week client delivery activities for change management and training workstreams, including planning, coordination, execution tracking, risk management, and alignment with implementation priorities
Provide hands-on project management oversight by managing client-facing plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, and weekly task progress across change management, training, communications, and implementation activities
Collaborate and coordinate with client stakeholders, technical teams, workstream leads, and functional areas to manage dependencies, resolve issues, and keep implementation activities moving forward
Support IT-enabled initiatives and system implementations by ramping up quickly on new concepts, understanding new systems, and translating client business needs into actionable change and training plans
Work within agile delivery environments, supporting planning routines, backlog visibility, task tracking, client updates, and implementation coordination using tools such as Jira
Plan, develop, and deliver virtual and in-person instructor-led training, adapting materials and facilitation approaches for different client audiences, user groups, and stakeholder needs
Draft client-ready communications, training content, job aids, briefings, and other materials that make complex system changes understandable for executive, program office, and broad agency audiences
Translate complex data, technical information, and system changes into actionable insights and clear recommendations for client leadership and stakeholder audiences
Own client deliverable quality by identifying, correcting, and preventing errors, and holding the team accountable for producing accurate, client-ready work
Apply business graphic design principles to produce high-quality, visually compelling deliverables
Mentor and oversee junior staff, reinforcing accountability, quality, and consistency in delivery
Support workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, and professional development efforts
Foster a collaborative, customer-focused environment that promotes accountability and continuous improvement
Identify opportunities to streamline operations through automation, analytics, dashboards, and business process re-design.

In addition to client delivery, you will play an important leadership role within the account by:

Developing and mentoring junior team members, building core consulting, communication, and delivery skills
Supporting business development efforts through research, solutioning, proposal development, market analysis, and capture activities
Driving internal initiatives such as Project Management Office (PMO) development, culture-building activities, Corporate Social Responsibility efforts, Lunch and Learns, and All-Hands meetings
Creating and maturing tools, templates, and capabilities that strengthen account delivery and operational excellence
Authoring and improving internal policies, procedures, and processes to enhance quality, consistency, and scalability
Serving as a day-to-day guide for junior staff, reinforcing strong consulting practices and high-quality client service delivery
Collaborating closely with Managers and Associate Directors to align on client priorities, delivery objectives, team performance, and business development opportunities
Demonstrating leadership and internal impact through active participation in account initiatives, knowledge sharing, continuous improvement efforts, and cross-functional collaboration

What You Will Need

Bachelor’s degree
3+ years of professional experience supporting federal clients, with demonstrated success in project management and delivery execution
Demonstrated experience developing client-ready communications, briefings, and presentations tailored to executive, program office, and broad stakeholder audiences
Experience managing multiple project teams, including assigning work, tracking progress, and validating deliverables against defined timeline
Experience managing staffing allocations across several workstreams on a weekly basis
Strong project management background, including planning, execution, coordination across workstreams, risk management, and performance tracking
Experience supporting or delivering IT-related projects or business system implementations
Experience supporting change management, training, communications, or adoption activities for system implementations
Ability to quickly learn new systems, concepts, and processes and translate them into clear training and communications for varied audiences
Strong business graphic design and presentation development skills, including advanced use of PowerPoint
Experience with Microsoft Office 365 tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint) to support analysis and decision-making
Ability to work independently with minimal oversight while maintaining alignment with leadership priorities
Experience capturing stakeholder requirements, conducting process analysis, and developing actionable solutions
Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance (i.e. US citizenship is required)

What Would Be Nice To Have

Master’s degree
Experience supporting executive leadership at the Food and Drug Administration
Experience working in business transformation or centralized operating models
Experience applying data visualization tools to communicate insights
Familiarity with federal budget, acquisition, and financial management processes
Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher preferred)
Change Management Certified Professional (CCMP) certification
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
Technical background
Familiarity with agile delivery practices and tools, such as Jira
Proven ability to operate in a high-tempo environment with competing priorities
Strong attention to detail with a track record of delivering high-quality, accurate work

The annual salary range for this position is $98,000.00-$163,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

new_jobs.description:
Drive High-Impact Revenue Execution as Sales Enablement Program Manager!

Bridge global strategy with regional execution by tailoring sales enablement, driving tool adoption, and elevating seller performance across the AECO sector. You will empower field sales teams to accelerate market success.

About Us

Trimble is empowering stakeholders through planning, design, construction and the entire asset lifecycle. The company’s innovative and connected ecosystem of solutions improves coordination and collaboration between teams, phases and processes. Automating work and transforming workflows, Trimble is enabling teams to deliver with confidence at every turn. For more information, visit: construction.trimble.com.

What Makes This Role Great

You will serve as the critical bridge between global strategy and local field success, directly influencing regional revenue performance and shaping future global enablement programs through real-world field insights .

Key Exciting Responsibilities

Lead the regional activation of programs to accelerate time-to-productivity for sales talent.
Drive deep field adoption and analytics-based coaching using premier tech stack tools including Seismic, Gong, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
Translate global GTM campaigns, product launches, and sales playbooks into compelling, localized customer success stories.
Identify high-impact regional enablement initiatives and scale them into standardized global frameworks.
Gather field intelligence and seller feedback to continuously optimize the central enablement strategy.

Essential Skills & Experience

3–5 years of experience in regional sales enablement, program management, or field delivery within enterprise B2B technology.
Demonstrated success executing onboarding programs that measurably reduce seller time-to-ramp.
Hands-on expertise driving adoption and extracting analytics from tools like Seismic, Gong, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
Strong ability to localize global sales messaging and assets for regional buying behaviors and dynamics.

Bonus Points For

Solid understanding of the construction technology landscape and AECO buyer personas.
Proven ability to navigate a global matrixed organization and advocate for regional field needs.

Logistics

Location: Westminster, CO; Portland, OR; Alpharetta, GA - In office

Travel Requirement: 10%

Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. new_jobs.title: Research Analyst
new_jobs.description:
TL;DR
Kharon is seeking a full-time Research Analyst based in NYC or Washington D.C. This role requires frequent in-office attendance.

Kharon is a highly disruptive and incredibly innovative organization that navigates risk at the intersection of global security threats + international commerce.

What does that mean? Great question.

Operating at the nexus of global security, Kharon is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take really complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible. From financial crimes and sanctions to export controls and threat identifications, our tools optimize protection against the types of risks that could otherwise be incredibly dangerous and excessively costly to any business. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. Now, we’re experiencing unprecedented growth. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products. Given the significance of our work and the increasing global reliance on our insights, we are looking for a data-forward Research Analyst focusing on sanctions monitoring, to join us as we work to shape the way businesses perceive and navigate global risks.

The core of this position is dedicated to conducting open-source research on a variety of foreign affairs and national security issues. More specifically, you will be researching, analyzing, and interpreting data as it relates to sanctions, export controls, and criminal/illicit networks. You will be responsible for the diligent pursuit of data as it relates to ever-evolving market demand and our client inquiries. Working collaboratively with the Kharon Research team, you will contribute to the development of new datasets and update existing ones, identifying and utilizing new sources and developing subject matter expertise on the various strategic topics.

This includes monitoring new sanctions, enforcement actions, and policy activity by regulatory agencies, as well as conducting research on international affairs that affect business risks. Leveraging your sound analytical approach and research techniques, you will identify data typologies, perform detailed quality assurance, validate and reconcile data, and support new product and partnership initiatives. You’ll also play a key role in curating, publishing, and maintaining datasets, and may write original code to collect primary data across various languages. Cross-functional collaboration is essential as you help build out new research, surface insights from existing content, and report key project metrics to internal stakeholders.

To the right person, this will be the perfect kind of challenge. Our mission is compelling, our product is powerful and we’re growing at a rate that makes us unstoppable. If you’re looking to be surrounded by people who will inspire you to think and challenge you to grow then look no further. Our team is made up of some of the most visionary and uncompromising individuals you will ever encounter. We don’t take ourselves seriously but we’re serious about the work we do and there is absolutely no slowing us down.

Responsibilities

Monitoring new sanctions, enforcement actions, and policy activity by regulatory agencies for developments relevant to Kharon’s products
Driving the curation, publication, maintenance, and quality assurance of datasets
Performing data validation and reconciliation to support new products and partnership initiatives
Conducting research on issues in international affairs that impact business risks and identifying relevant data sources
Accurately perform detailed quality assurance of data and developing additional tooling to support these tasks as necessary
Writes original code to assist in automating data analysis, cleanup, and enhancements

Qualifications

Must have a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business Administration, International Relations, Political Science, Security Studies, Regional Studies, History, Sociology, or a related field.
Must have at least 1-3 years of professional experience with sanctions, export controls, anti-money laundering or countering the financing of terrorism, and experience researching issues of international security and economy in high-risk jurisdictions.
Experience with or willingness to learn SQL.
Experience with data analysis, data visualization, and graph databases (Neo4J).
Understanding of or willingness to learn web technologies (HTML, JavaScript, CSS, XPath, JSON, etc).

Benefits

To keep that momentum going, we do our very best to make sure that each and every team member is completely taken care of. We’re nothing without our people and we strive to offer a package that reflects that. As a Kharon team member, you can expect:
Fully sponsored medical, dental, and vision
FSA program for both medical and dependent care
401k + Roth with matching and immediate vesting
Paid time off + 11 paid holidays

The base salary range at Kharon is set between $68,000-$78,000. Please note that this figure does not necessarily include potential bonuses, commissions, benefits, or equity that may be part of the overall compensation package.

If interested in pursuing this position, please visit www.kharon.com to apply.
